description: Timestamp a SHA-256 and get a receipt. Free, no account. Only the digest is stored — the document never reaches this server and cannot. The receipt states plainly what it proves now (the operator's timestamp) and what it proves after the next seal (anyone can check it without trusting the operator). Same digest, same receipt.

sha256.description: 64 hex characters — a sha256 digest. Other names accepted: hash, digest.

name: project100_notarize
